description: Empirically researched music video producer style profiles. Used by MVDirector (mv_director.py) to inject per-segment shot directives into plan_segments() system prompt. Profiles are pure data — edit freely without code changes. Each profile lists verifiable signature videos for traceability.

producers.name: Dave Meyers
producers.ethos_oneliner: High-concept surreal set-pieces stitched together with whiplash edits — each verse is a new vignette built around one iconic, art-reference-loaded image.

videos_analyzed.title: HUMBLE.
videos_analyzed.notes: Chained tableaux: pope vestments, Last Supper recreation, golf-course bowing servants, fisheye CU, monk gathering. Hard high-contrast key, deep blacks, gold accents. Static centered framing alternating with extreme fisheye CU.

videos_analyzed.title: Sicko Mode
videos_analyzed.notes: Kaleidoscopic Houston-at-night fantasia: melting buildings, fluorescent purple/cyan, giant baby/toy iconography, cherry-red lowriders, double-exposure morphs. Every beat-switch triggers world-change.

videos_analyzed.title: bad guy
videos_analyzed.notes: High-key oversaturated yellow/hot-pink/cream sets, Toiletpaper-style absurd tableaux. Centered symmetrical compositions, locked-off camera, hard direct flash. Palette shift on bass-drop.

producers.opening_pattern: Cold open on a single arresting symmetrical tableau, hold 3-5 seconds, then beat drops into rapid vignette cuts.

producers.name: Melina Matsoukas
producers.ethos_oneliner: Documentary-grounded cultural portraiture: real locations, low-light realism, and choreography staged as community ritual rather than studio spectacle.

videos_analyzed.title: We Found Love
videos_analyzed.notes: Doomed-couple narrative in Belfast estates. Handheld 16mm-look grain, heavy practical neons, strobe-cut montage, bleach-bypass blue/teal shadows under warm skin. Skateboard tracking, macro CU of pills, lips, hands.

videos_analyzed.title: Formation
videos_analyzed.notes: New Orleans post-Katrina iconography — sinking police car, antebellum porch, second-line dancers, hooded boy. Slow dolly tracking, painterly natural interiors, hard noon sun exteriors. Wide MLS group choreo in parking lot.

videos_analyzed.title: Pretty Hurts
videos_analyzed.notes: Beauty pageant tragedy in single fluorescent-lit backstage. Cold white practicals, motel-green walls, handheld observational coverage. Long lens MCU of Beyonce silently breaking, intercut locker-room destruction WS.

producers.opening_pattern: Slow location-establishing shot or VO/diegetic-audio cold open — wide on a real place before the song proper begins.

producers.name: Floria Sigismondi
producers.ethos_oneliner: Surrealist gothic theatre: painterly tableaux, prosthetic body distortion, and a jittery hand-cranked camera that turns pop performance into hallucinatory ritual.

videos_analyzed.title: Unholy
videos_analyzed.notes: Burlesque-cabaret hellscape: red-velvet curtained club, latex/leather costuming, smoke and gilded ornament. Warm amber/crimson key with hard rim, deep black negative space. Undercranked twitchy camera, fashion-editorial poses. MCU+MS dominant.

videos_analyzed.title: Mirrors
videos_analyzed.notes: Time-lapse love story across decades in art-deco hotel and mirror-walled rooms. Cool blue/silver palette, slow tracking through symmetrical corridors, dual-exposure reflections. Slow dolly, soft top key, silk diffusion.

videos_analyzed.title: The Beautiful People
videos_analyzed.notes: Career-defining freak-show vocabulary: stilts, prosthetic mouths, dental headgear, sepia/bleach skip-frame jittery camera, Diane Arbus-style grotesque portraiture. Hard side-key with industrial green-yellow shadow.

producers.opening_pattern: Slow reveal on a single painterly tableau or costumed figure — curtain rising, door opening, or slow push into a symmetrical space.

producers.name: Anton Corbijn
producers.ethos_oneliner: Stark monochrome portraiture of the band as mythic, weather-beaten figures in austere landscapes.

videos_analyzed.title: Enjoy the Silence
videos_analyzed.notes: 16mm grainy footage, Dave Gahan as a king in red cloak/crown crossing alpine, desert and coastal landscapes carrying a deck chair. Cool desaturated palette, available daylight, very wide LS/EWS broken by tight portrait CUs.

videos_analyzed.title: One (v1)
videos_analyzed.notes: Sepia/monochrome footage of Bono in smoky Berlin bar, intercut slow-mo buffalo running off cliff. Warm amber tungsten, heavy grain, static locked-off frames + slow dollies, MCU/CU dominant.

videos_analyzed.title: Heart-Shaped Box
videos_analyzed.notes: Surreal Wizard-of-Oz colour scheme — hyper-saturated reds/yellows vs bleached high-key whites. Aged crucified Santa, fetuses on tree. Static wide tableau + handheld band performance. Heavy grain, painterly framing, mythic-religious iconography.

producers.opening_pattern: Cold open on a wide static landscape or a tight monochrome portrait held in silence before the first downbeat.

producers.name: Samuel Bayer
producers.ethos_oneliner: Sweat-stained, smoke-filled performance energy on grainy bleach-bypass film, the band as sneering anti-heroes.

videos_analyzed.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
videos_analyzed.notes: High-school pep-rally gymnasium with anarchist cheerleaders, bleach-bypass desaturated greens/ambers, smoky volumetric haze pierced by harsh top light. Handheld shaky on floor, fast on-beat cutting between band MS and crowd-mosh WS. The template for 90s grunge video grammar.

videos_analyzed.title: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
videos_analyzed.notes: Desert highway/Mojave wasteland narrative, sun-bleached high-contrast grade, band walking the empty road intercut broken-down car performance. Wide LS landscapes, low-angle hero MS, heavy lens flares, motivated practical headlights at night.

videos_analyzed.title: Wake Me Up When September Ends
videos_analyzed.notes: Narrative-driven mini-film: young couple, boyfriend enlists. Warm golden-hour intimate exteriors vs cold blue military interiors, anamorphic lens, slow dollies in story scenes, harder handheld in performance, tight CU on tearful faces.

producers.opening_pattern: Cold open on a single iconic image (janitor mopping, cracked windshield, empty highway), then hard cut on first power chord into band.

producers.name: Mark Romanek
producers.ethos_oneliner: Meticulously composed, gallery-grade tableaux that turn a song into a single unflinching confessional image.

videos_analyzed.title: Closer
videos_analyzed.notes: Victorian-scientific-laboratory aesthetic — taxidermied animals, crucified monkey, anatomical diagrams. Sepia/bleach-bypass distressed film treatment mimicking decayed early cinema. Static locked symmetrical tableau, Reznor in restraints. Permanent MoMA collection.

videos_analyzed.title: The Perfect Drug
videos_analyzed.notes: Gothic Edward-Gorey manor estate, deep emeralds, rich crimson, candlelit interiors. Reznor in Victorian mourning, absinthe. Symmetrical wide-master tableau, slow dollies, painterly chiaroscuro.

videos_analyzed.title: Hurt
videos_analyzed.notes: Single location (abandoned House of Cash museum) + Cash's home. Warm desaturated tungsten, dust motes in shafts of window light. Almost entirely static MCU/CU of hands, face, decaying memorabilia, intercut archival footage. Edit on emotion, not beat.

producers.opening_pattern: Open on a single still-life detail (object, hand, wide symmetrical room) held in silence before the first note.

producers.name: Harold 'Hype' Williams
producers.ethos_oneliner: Maximalist luxury opulence shot through fisheye glass — bodies, bottles, and chrome smeared in saturated color until the frame itself feels expensive.

videos_analyzed.title: Mo Money Mo Problems
videos_analyzed.artist: The Notorious B.I.G. ft. Puff Daddy & Mase
videos_analyzed.notes: Tuxedo-and-shiny-suit performance on solid color cyc (red, gold, silver), wide fisheye on dance line, mirrored floor, crisp gel-lit primaries, on-beat cuts to Bad Boy ensemble choreo, intercut golf-course skit.

videos_analyzed.title: The Rain (Supa Dupa Fly)
videos_analyzed.notes: Inflated black trash-bag suit on infinity-white cyc, extreme fisheye CU of Missy's distorted face, chrome-and-pearl props, jump cuts on snare, alien-glamour wardrobe, hard-key + colored gel rim.

videos_analyzed.title: Big Pimpin'
videos_analyzed.notes: Yacht in Trinidad Carnival, helicopter overhead WS, bikini crowd circle, drenched golden-hour sun + saturated blue water, slow-mo champagne pour, fisheye on deck dance.

producers.opening_pattern: Hero shot on saturated infinity cyc OR aerial pull-back from an overtly expensive location (yacht, helicopter, mansion), beat-synced cut on the one.

producers.name: Hiro Murai
producers.ethos_oneliner: Cinematic surreal allegory — long takes, naturalistic light, and one unsettling visual idea per video that makes the song mean more than its lyrics.

videos_analyzed.title: This Is America
videos_analyzed.notes: Single warehouse, oner-style long takes following Glover through choreographed crowd. Naturalistic top light, desaturated warm palette, choreography foreground vs violence/riot in deep background, abrupt tonal cuts on gunshots.

videos_analyzed.title: Sweatpants
videos_analyzed.notes: Diner + suburban-uncanny where every extra slowly becomes a duplicate of Gambino. MS/MCU dolly through booth, flat fluorescent practicals, muted teal/cream, slow-burn surreal escalation, locked-off symmetric framing.

videos_analyzed.title: Grief
videos_analyzed.notes: Shot on thermal/infrared camera, ghostly white-on-black bodies, near-zero recognizable faces, claustrophobic CU, cuts run against the rhythm, body-horror imagery, oppressive sensor grain.

producers.opening_pattern: Quiet ambient location with one off-kilter detail; artist enters frame walking, often without a hard cut for 20+ seconds.

producers.name: Cole Bennett
producers.ethos_oneliner: Cartoon-overlay hyperreality — saturated cell-shaded color, hand-drawn 2D animation pasted onto live action, edited like a meme to the snare.

videos_analyzed.title: Lucid Dreams
videos_analyzed.notes: Pastel pink-and-blue exterior, hand-drawn animated stars/flames overlaid on artist, freeze-frame + bounce, MCU centered, doubled/ghosted artist body, on-snare cuts, soft Chicago daylight + ring-light, lo-fi VHS bumper.

videos_analyzed.title: Godzilla
videos_analyzed.notes: Cartoon kaiju animation destroys Detroit skyline behind Eminem. Handheld MCU of artist rapping to lens, Mike Tyson + Dr. Dre cameo cuts, rapid double-time edits, super-saturated, lens-warp speed FX.

videos_analyzed.title: D Rose
videos_analyzed.notes: Bedroom/garage low-budget look, animated dollar signs and stars drawn over frame, fisheye-ish wide on Pump's face, blown-out highlights, MCU handheld, jump cuts on every kick, Chicago Bulls iconography, Lyrical Lemonade title card.

producers.opening_pattern: Lyrical Lemonade animated title card or lemon logo, hard cut to artist MCU mid-lyric on saturated exterior.
